# The CLI answers the Skill call with Unknown skill. The engine does not read the result of the call: the sweep step starts with the line that loads the skill, and the item goes on to the review.
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
grep -count=1 '^sweep ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^/beehave-skills:the-review-skill$' sweepline.log
grep '^review ' calls.log

-- verdicts --
approve
